scripts.dev: concurrently -n mtx,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @broviki/mediamtx" "npm run dev -w @broviki/api" "npm run dev -w @broviki/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @broviki/api && npm run build -w @broviki/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n mtx,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run start -w @broviki/mediamtx" "npm run start:prod -w @broviki/api" "npm run start -w @broviki/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @broviki/api --if-present && npm run lint -w @broviki/web --if-present
